CustomField.description: Subheading for the delete-confirmation modal on Table sections, passed as delete-modal-subheading to c-flow-data-table. Applies only to Table component types when Enable Delete Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Smaller text under the title of the delete-confirmation popup on a Table section. Applies to Tables only and requires Enable Delete Action.
CustomField.label: Modal Subtitle
